name: finviz_health_live_probe_lq1310_20261108
comment: LQ-20261107-1310: _finviz_credential_health_live decided health with `bool(ok) and not
is_finviz_cookie_failure_text(last_error)`, so a stored data_source_health.last_error outvoted a
live probe that had just succeeded — Friday 2026-11-08 18:25 ET the operator renewed FINVIZ_COOKIE
and the banner stayed up 'expired' on the old text. The live probe is now the verdict; the stored
text is still disclosed in last_error but cannot flip ok to expired, and a failing live probe still
raises the banner. Stub DB row, stub validators, no secret read, no network.
